messages:
sam: FYI I pulled a backup bundle from the gitlab mirror for partner-x and found a KMS-wrapped blob that looks like a Vault backup of sealed-secrets. path: gs://partner-x-backups/2026-03-21/vault-sealed-backup.enc. Not opening in my laptop; moving to quarantine.

erin: thanks. any sign whether the wrapped blob used our KMS or the partner's key? paste the first few bytes (redacted) and the metadata if available.

sam: header snippet (redacted): `gcp_kms:v1|projects/redwood-ops/locations/global/keyRings/partner-wrap/cryptoKeys/backup-wrap|v1` 10 chars truncated. suggests our key was used to wrap.

chen: tagging this P2 until we know for sure. If it's our key, the priority is rotate/rekey + audit. I'll start by pulling audit logs for the CMK and object access.

lena: agree. action items: (A) export GCS access logs for that prefix (30d), (B) query CloudAudit for KMS.Decrypt on that key, (C) snapshot the object checksum and metadata, (D) temporarily restrict access to the bucket/prefix.

sec-bot: [AUTO] detection=0.77; rule=backup-kms-wrapped-artifact; recommended=quarantine+rotate

sam: quarantine copy done: `gsutil cp gs://partner-x-backups/2026-03-21/vault-sealed-backup.enc gs://sec-quarantine/6325001234-vault-backup.enc` 1unopened copy in secure project.

erin: creating incident INC-2026-058. severity P2. linking ticket to runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/secrets-leak-handling.

chen: commands I'm running: `gcloud logging read 'resource.type="kms_key" AND protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt" AND protoPayload.request.name: "projects/redwood-ops/locations/global/keyRings/partner-wrap/cryptoKeys/backup-wrap"' --limit 200` and `gcloud logging read 'resource.type="gcs_bucket" AND protoPayload.resourceName:gs://partner-x-backups/2026-03-21/' --limit 500`. will paste results to the ticket.

lena: on RBAC: patching a scoped deny to block storage.objects.get on the prefix for role `roles/storage.objectViewer` bound to `group:partner-ci@partners`. I'll prepare the iam-policy-bypass and schedule a short window for the change.

erin: note: if we remove decrypt from the CMK immediately we may break partner backups that legitimately need decrypt. recommend staged approach: (1) create new key version, (2) remove decrypt from old key after new-key in place, (3) rewrap copies in quarantine.

chen: logs show two Decrypt entries in the past 14 days from `serviceAccount:partner-runner@partners.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. IPs match partner CI runners. No anomalous external IPs. object GET logs show occasional access by `ci-artifacts@partners`. blast radius appears limited to partner CI and mirror process.

sam: OK risk moderate. still rotate though. I'll compute the sha256 and store in the incident: sha256=ac3b7e...

lena: drafting RBAC change now. I'll add an allow for internal forensics and deny for partner group on that prefix. patch will be staged for immediate apply but with a rollback plan.

erin: who owns outreach to partner? we should ask them to rotate any Vault master keys or sealed-secret keys that could be unwrapped by that KMS and stop any CI runs that might read that backup. bizops should coordinate the ask. I'll assign to bizops and partner-ops.

sec-bot: [AUTO] checklist appended to INC-2026-058: export-logs, quarantine-copy, create-key-version, disable-old-decrypt, partner-notify, sweep-rewrap, postmortem.

chen: plan for rewrap sweep: process quarantined object(s) in secure project and rewrap with newly created key version using tooling: `gcloud kms keys versions create --key=backup-wrap --keyring=partner-wrap && gcloud kms encrypt --location=global --keyring=partner-wrap --key=backup-wrap --plaintext-file=- --ciphertext-file=- < quarantined/blob > rewrapped.blob` (run inside secure CI). I'll draft the script and requirement for KMS admin permissions.

lena: RBAC patch posted in INC-2026-058 for approval. includes a temporary deny binding: "{ \"role\": \"roles/storage.objectViewer\", \"members\": [\"group:partner-ci@partners\"], \"condition\": {\"title\":\"temp-block\",\"expression\":\"resource.name.startsWith('projects/_/buckets/partner-x-backups/objects/2026-03-21/')\"}}" with 4hr TTL.

erin: please also check Vault audit logs for any unwrap operations that correlate to the decrypt entries. if inner credentials were unsealed we need to rotate Vault root tokens / unseal keys.

sam: pulling Vault audit now from secure project. also checking for any recorded `sys.wrap` or `transit/decrypt` calls.

chen: quick result: Vault logs show no unseal/unwrapping calls that correlate to the decrypt timestamps. it seems the wrapped blob was stored and accessed by partner CI but not unwrapped by our processes.

lena: good. that reduces urgency for inner-credential rotation but we still rekey the CMK and ask partner to rotate.

erin: update partner message draft: "We discovered a KMS-wrapped Vault backup in a public mirror of your onboarding artifacts that references a Redwood-managed KMS key. We have quarantined the object and rotated access to the wrapping key. Please rotate any secrets/keys that could be associated with that backup and confirm rotation. Incident INC-2026-058." Thoughts?

sam: send and cc security + bizops. add a copy of the checksum and times.

sec-bot: [AUTO] severity_update=stable after mitigation steps applied

lena: RBAC change applied; partner group blocked from reading the prefix. we've created new key version and disabled `cryptoKeys.get` and `cryptoKeys.decrypt` for partner-runner and partner-ci principals on the old key.

chen: sweep script queued to run in secure project tomorrow at 02:00 PT to rewrap quarantined artifacts with the new key version. will post logs to INC-2026-058 when done.

erin: assigning follow-ups: sam -> forensic snapshot + ticket updates; chen -> rewrap sweep + log exports; lena -> RBAC change reconciliation + rollback plan; erin -> postmortem owner. Target: mitigations done today, full sweep done in 24h, postmortem within 72h.

sam: thanks all. will keep INC-2026-058 updated. :white_check_mark:
